description: Go somewhere: the Commons (commons), the Dance Hall (hall), the playa, the wilds to gather (woodlot, quarry, meadow, scrapyard), a town building on the plaza (post office, reading room, market hall, workshop, bakery café, town hall), a room of the house (kitchen, garden), or home.
